message.text: Taken. One builder is turning this card into a single screen: a one-line summary (tasks, agents, cost, done), then one short row per task with your original ask, status and cost, and the details folded behind each row.

Done. The AI dashboard card now opens with "8 tasks · 21 agents · $57.54+ · 8 done", then one row per task, biggest cost first. Each row shows the first line of your original words, its agents and cost, and a one-sentence outcome, with the details folded one click down. It loaded with no console errors; I haven't opened it myself. Say so if you want other group cards to follow it.
